newsitem.title: USA: ADC Telecom to take $23-mln charge in Q1.
newsitem.headline: ADC Telecom to take $23-mln charge in Q1.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc said Thursday it expects to record a non-recurring charge of about $23 million, or $0.11 a share after taxes, in the first quarter ended January 31.

The company said the charge primarily represents the estimated write-off related to the acquisition of Pacific Communications Sciences Inc from Cirrus Logic Inc in December. The charge will also cover estimated expenses related to a consolidation and streamlining of its West Coast operations, the company said.
ADC said without the charge, net income in the period would be $0.19 a share, compared to $0.13 a share in 1995.
The company expects to report final results for first fiscal quarter February 24.
ADC Telecommunications develops equipment for telephone companies as well as wireless, broadcast and cable television operators.
Its shares closed down 3/8 Thursday at 35.
